Lessons.Title: An Assortment of Fractions
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will use equivalence to reason about problems that involve combining or removing fractional amounts.
Key idea: Fraction addition and subtraction can combine halves, thirds and sixths by expressing every addend in common fractional units.
How to reason: Pick a common denominator and rewrite before combining parts; also estimate against one whole.

Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Which One Doesn't Belong: Halves, Fourths, Sixths, and Eights (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Priya says that if they combine their towers to make a super tall tower, it would be too tall for the room and they’ll have to remove one brick..
